headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 flash sets an all-time record at 40.7% of tokens, and DeepSeek as a provider hits 47.8%
summary: DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 took the top spot with 40.7% of tokens, a fresh all-time high, and DeepSeek as a provider now holds 47.8%, up 24.6% over seven days. Tencent still sits second, and between them the top two providers account for 60.6%.
highlights: Record: deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 holds 40.7% of tokens, the highest share on record, and it's the first day of that record.
DeepSeek's provider share is 47.8% today, up 5.1% in one day and 24.6% over seven days.
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 60.6% of tokens; Zhipu AI in third brings the top three to 66.2%.
Tencent's provider share fell 33.9% over seven days, though it remains in second place at 12.7%.
New entrants: particle-ai's particle-1 (rank 44), Google's gemini-3.1-flash-lite (rank 49), and MiniMax's minimax-m3 (rank 51).
Dropouts: stepfun's step-5-preview (last ranked 14th), Qwen's qwen3.6-35b-a3b (last ranked 34th), and Perplexity's pplx-decider-v1.3 (last ranked 36th).
